money_doc_change.section: global/money/doc.md, 'The Probashi Card' (and the matching sentence in 'In one minute')
money_doc_change.why: The money doc's latest status is 31 Aug 2026 ('Janata Bank pilot due to start in September', GM0351) with a Need to know asking whether it started. Later reports: Prothom Alo 5 Sep 2026 says the card had not been introduced and was still at the preparation stage; on 13 Oct 2026 the state minister said it was being piloted in four to five countries. The services doc now carries only a short summary pointing to the money doc, so the money doc should hold the full account including these.
add_after_the_31_August_line: Prothom Alo reported on 5 September 2026 that the card had not yet been introduced, unlike the government's Family card and Farmer card, and was still at the preparation stage, although the minister had announced in February 2026 that it would come soon. Source: pa-2026-09-05-qgoar1unuj (https://www.prothomalo.com/bangladesh/qgoar1unuj); quotes in services facts GV0234, GV0235.

On 13 October 2026 the state minister for expatriates' welfare, Md. Nurul Haque, said the card was being piloted in four to five countries, including Jordan, South Korea and several Middle Eastern countries, that it is planned to allow financial transactions and payments at home and abroad, and that card holders are planned to get a 3% incentive on remittances sent through legal channels, against 2.5% now. Source: pa-2026-10-13-12w6w1o0ym (https://www.prothomalo.com/bangladesh/12w6w1o0ym); quotes in services GV0268, GV0269 (also dalal-scams GS0073).

Optional, for completeness: Mahdi Amin, the Prime Minister's adviser, told an EU delegation on 10 June 2026 that an 'Expatriate card' was planned (pa-2026-06-10-72vsv7uhob, GV0206); the minister said on 30 August 2026 the card would be finalised under the government's 180-day programme (pa-2026-08-31-xr745r2u4c, GV0230); the 21 July 2026 civil aviation ministry meeting set out a special Biman ticket discount and Balaka lounge discount (policy decision taken), priority check-in and boarding, and a discount under consideration at Parjatan Corporation hotels (pa-2026-07-21-chrjiusr0h, GV0216-GV0220). The services doc keeps these airport benefits under its airport section.
